On the chart: drag the TP / SL buttons off the position line to set them, drag any order line to move it, ✕ to cancel. Right-click (or long-press on a phone) to place a limit or stop at that price.

Price ladder

Tap the blue side to buy, the red side to sell; above or below the last price becomes a limit or stop automatically. Uses the Order tab's quantity and TP/SL. No depth sizes are shown: this free feed has none, and none are invented.

Real NQ, MNQ, ES and MES one-minute bars from Yahoo, replayed with no invented prices. A candle is stepped through its open, extremes and close; with a trade on, the move against you is assumed to come first, so a stop and a target inside one candle resolve to the stop. Fills are simulated, not Tradovate's. Practice only, not advice. Rules are editable under Rules; check them against your own Apex account.

Account rules & costs

Defaults follow the commonly published Apex 25K intraday-trailing evaluation, but Apex changes its rules and published figures disagree, so match these to the numbers on your own account.
